description.zh:
待添加的设备列表，需传入设备对应的**IotId**，该参数可以通过调用[QueryDevice](~~69905~~)获取。

>如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**。如果您同时传入**IotIdList**和**ProductKey**，则以**IotIdList**为准。
description.en:
The list of devices to add. You must specify the **IotId** of each device. You can obtain this parameter by invoking the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) API.

>If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey**. If you specify both **IotIdList** and **ProductKey**, **IotIdList** takes precedence.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of your current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation fails.
- If the **Instance Overview** page or the ID does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
待添加设备所属产品的**ProductKey**。

您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用接口[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)，查看当前实例下所有产品的信息。
description.en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices to add belong.

You can view information about all products in the current instance in the IoT Platform console or by invoking the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) API.
The ID of the share task.

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
单次调用本接口添加设备的数量不能超过50。

## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To
You cannot add more than 50 devices in a single API call.

## Queries per second (QPS) limit
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account is 5 when calling this API.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot add-share-task-device --share-task-id Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --iot-instance-id iot-v6400000000 --product-key a2YwD23000 --iot-id-list example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot AddShareTaskDevice --region cn-hangzhou --IotInstanceId 'iot-v6400000000' --ShareTaskId Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --IotIdList.1 'example-string' --ProductKey a2YwD23000
